title: Account for impairment of indefinite life intangible assets and goodwill

items.concept: Subsequent measurement schedules for indefinite-life trade name and reporting-unit goodwill (zero amortization; impairment-only write-downs); initial recognition; period-end quantitative impairment JEs; disposal after impairment
Number-variant twin — multi-year subsequent measurement schedules for indefinite-life trademark and RU goodwill; initial recognition; period-end impairment JEs; disposal with loss
Period-end adjusting impairment tests — goodwill loss capped at allocated goodwill; indefinite-life asset with FV ≥ CA (no loss); qualitative assessment avoids quantitative test; presentation
Quantitative goodwill impairment measurement and cap at allocated goodwill
Quantitative impairment model for indefinite-life intangible assets other than goodwill (no undiscounted recoverability step)
